senses.gloss:
पिज(इ)पिजि r. 2nd cl. (पिंक्ते)
 1. To tinge, to dye or colour, to
impinge.
 2. To touch.
 3. To tinkle.
 4. To adore. r. 1st and
10th cls. (पिञ्जति पिञ्जयति-ते)
 1. To kill or injure.
 2. To be strong.
3. To give.
 4. To dwell.
 5. To speak.
 6. To shine. दीप्तौ वासे
सामर्थ्येच अक० हिंसायां दानेच सक० चु० उभ० सेट् इदित् ।
